mechanism_narrative: A sustained federal funds rate below 0.5% compresses equity discount rates through reduced risk-free rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days as monetary policy accommodates economic weakness.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 8.0% signals severe economic distress triggering government stimulus and central bank intervention, producing positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST < 450.0) and weak GDP growth (GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5% annualized) signals imminent recession, prompting aggressive policy response that drives positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when both HOUST < 450.0 and GDPC1 growth rate < 0.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Monetary easing cycles (FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and declining) reduce equity risk premiums through lower discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.5% and declining.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (index, 2017=100) indicates manufacturing contraction, triggering central bank stimulus and positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when INDPRO < 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent unemployment rate rise (UNRATE > 8.0%) and payroll decline (PAYEMS < 133,000) signals labor market crisis, prompting aggressive policy that generates positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when UNRATE > 8.0% and PAYEMS < 133000.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained high retail sales (RSAFS > 340,000 million dollars) indicates strong consumer spending, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when RSAFS > 340,000.

mechanism_narrative: CPI index below 210 (index, 1982-1984=100) signals low inflation, enabling sustained low interest rates that support equity valuations and generate positive S&P 500 returns over 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 50% of instances when CPIAUCSL < 210.0.
